verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a GPU cloud provider, since such vendors can offer on-prem or self-managed deployments of their platform, so the axis applies. Every item in the pack describes Lambda-operated infrastructure: On-Demand Cloud, 1-Click Clusters, and Managed Kubernetes and Slurm. Even Private Cloud is a single-tenant cluster run by Lambda with low-level customer access, not software customers deploy on their own hardware. No evidence shows a self-hostable version of the core product.
